Civil Engineer | Transportation

Summary
Senior civil engineer with a transportation focus and experience delivering projects across land development, aviation, and water/wastewater sectors. - Directed the Round Rock Water Treatment Plant Expansion, supporting hydraulic and site design decisions and review with project stakeholders.
- Applied HEC-HMS for stormwater modeling and MicroStation for drafting across multiple sector assignments.

Senior Project Engineer, Kimley-Horn, Georgetown, TX
Oct 2019 - Dec 2023
- Managed civil engineering scope for the Round Rock Residential Subdivision ($85M), overseeing site grading, infrastructure layout, and permitting coordination.

- Oversaw the Round Rock Water Line Replacement, reviewing alignment, constructability, and utility conflicts before issuing plans for construction.

Civil Engineer in Training, Kimley-Horn, Georgetown, TX
Oct 2017 - Oct 2019
- Supported senior engineers on civil design and documentation for land development and water/wastewater projects.
- Prepared drawings and calculations in MicroStation and assisted with hydrology and hydraulic analyses.

Skills
OpenRoads Designer, HEC-HMS, Bluebeam Revu, MicroStation, Transportation Design, Stormwater Management, Project Coordination, Technical Documentation

Licenses & Certifications
P.E., Texas #135365

Education
M.S. in Civil Engineering, University of Houston, 2017

Civil Engineer | Drainage

Civil engineer with a focus on drainage and stormwater design across municipal infrastructure, aviation, and water/wastewater projects. 04/2024 - 10/2025

- Directed design for the Denton Downtown Streetscape, integrating drainage improvements with pedestrian and roadway elements for municipal stakeholders.

Project Engineer, Garver, Irving, TX
04/2020 - 04/2024
- Developed drainage plans, calculations, and construction documents for civil projects, supporting senior engineers through final design.
- Prepared HEC-HMS and HEC-RAS models to evaluate runoff and channel capacity for project design.

Civil Engineer in Training, Garver, Irving, TX
04/2018 - 04/2020
- Supported drainage and site civil design through CAD drafting and preparation of plan sheets in AutoCAD.
- Assisted with hydrologic analyses and documentation to support project teams on municipal and aviation work.

Toolbox
AutoCAD, HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS, Bluebeam Revu, OpenRoads Designer, Drainage Design, Hydrologic and Hydraulic Analysis, Construction Documentation

Structural engineer and project manager with nearly two decades of experience designing and managing structural systems for K-12 education, sports and entertainment, and multifamily projects. Registered Professional Engineer, State of Texas

andrea.reyes72@example.com | (469) 555-0147 | Dallas, TX
Construction Management | Project Management

Summary
Construction management professional with progressive project management experience across multifamily and mission critical / data center sectors. Brings a career-long track record of leading complex, multi-million-dollar projects from preconstruction through closeout, with a focus on schedule control, cost accountability and coordinated stakeholder delivery. Currently serving as Project Executive, providing senior leadership over data center hall fit-outs and mixed-use residential developments.

Experience
Project Executive, Hensel Phelps, Dallas, TX
10/24 - Present
- Provide executive oversight for Dallas Data Center Hall Fit-Out, Grapevine Data Center Hall Fit-Out ($50M) and Frisco Mixed-Use Apartments, aligning project teams, owners and subcontractors on scope, budget and schedule.
- Lead senior-level client relationships and strategic planning for mission critical / data center fit-out work, ensuring quality and commissioning milestones are achieved.
- Direct risk management, procurement strategy and cost forecasting across concurrent multifamily and data center portfolios.
- Mentor project managers and superintendents, fostering accountability and consistent project controls across teams.

Senior Project Manager, Hensel Phelps, Dallas, TX
03/20 - 10/24
- Managed full project lifecycles from preconstruction through closeout, coordinating design teams, trade partners and owner representatives.
- Oversaw budgets, change order management and schedule recovery to keep projects aligned with contractual commitments.

Senior Project Manager, Austin Commercial, Tulsa, OK
04/19 - 03/20
- Directed project delivery for Tulsa Mid-Rise Residential ($424M), coordinating subcontractor performance, submittals and inspections.
- Led cross-functional coordination among architects, engineers and field teams to resolve constructability issues and maintain schedule.

Senior Project Manager, DPR Construction, Dallas, TX
07/17 - 04/19
- Managed Carrollton Data Center Campus ($60M) and McKinney Data Center Campus ($113M), overseeing budgets, procurement and schedule controls.
- Coordinated owner, design and trade partner communication to support timely decisions on complex mission critical builds.

Senior Project Manager, Skanska, Dallas, TX
10/16 - 07/17
- Led project management for Denton Garden-Style Apartments, guiding budget tracking, subcontractor coordination and quality compliance.
- Monitored project schedules and cost reports to identify variances early and implement corrective actions.

Project Manager, Skanska, Dallas, TX
10/10 - 10/16
- Supported project delivery through RFI management, submittal tracking and subcontractor coordination.
- Assisted in preparing schedules and cost reports while maintaining documentation for project closeout.

Assistant Project Manager, Skanska, Dallas, TX
09/08 - 10/10
- Supported senior project managers with document control, meeting minutes and procurement tracking.
- Assisted with field coordination, site inspections and project reporting for active construction projects.

Skills
Sage 300 CRE, Primavera P6, Bluebeam Revu, PlanGrid, Microsoft Project, Budget & Cost Control, Schedule Management, Subcontractor Coordination

Education
B.B.A. in Business Administration, Baylor University, 2008

Selected Projects
- Dallas Data Center Hall Fit-Out (mission critical / data centers), Hensel Phelps
- Grapevine Data Center Hall Fit-Out ($50M, mission critical / data centers), Hensel Phelps
- Frisco Mixed-Use Apartments (multifamily), Hensel Phelps
- Tulsa Mid-Rise Residential ($424M, multifamily), Austin Commercial
- Carrollton Data Center Campus ($60M, mission critical / data centers), DPR Construction
- McKinney Data Center Campus ($113M, mission critical / data centers), DPR Construction
